result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. Its row is still rendered, with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add a new one, so the fix itself is untested.

The change is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the Sub-landscapes table code. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returned `null` when the file was missing or unreadable, but the caller then called `.getMetadata()` on that `null`. It now treats a `null` config as having no metadata, which falls into the existing default-logo branch. Sub-landscapes that do have a config keep their own logo.

I also guarded against a config that parses but has no metadata, since that would have hit the same crash.
